title: Redline: Ashfall
blurb:
Cross into the REDLINE—an unforgiving, persistent open-world warzone where tactical precision meets raw survival. Blending the emergent base-building and territorial warfare of Rust, the vast, unpredictable open-world tension of DayZ, and the high-stakes gunplay and extraction mechanics of Escape from Tarkov, REDLINE pushes realism and player-driven survival to the limit.

Enter hostile sectors alone or with a squad to scavenge high-tier weaponry, medical supplies, and rare components. Every engagement is governed by authentic milsim mechanics—realistic ballistics, modular weapon customization, stamina management, and a punishing health system where a single misstep can cost you everything you brought in.

title: Night Circuit
blurb: One lap, no headlights, the pack right behind you.

title: Ash Cathedral
blurb: A ruined nave, a locked choir, and a fire that never goes out.

title: Glass Harbor
blurb: Boats made of glass, and a tide that remembers your name.

title: Iron Orchard
blurb: Plant steel, harvest a skyline, hold the valley.

title: Velvet Static
blurb: Short range, loud rooms, and a signal that will not die.
